landing.visionP1: I am Leninistwarrior, as many know me across various platforms. Since November, I have been dedicated to creating this platform with a singular vision: to revitalize authentic Marxist analysis and provide a hub for writers with revolutionary potential.
landing.visionP2: In the latter part of the century, Marxism has been neglected and perverted beyond recognition. This site aims to correct this trajectory by returning to scientific principles while addressing contemporary conditions.
landing.visionP3: This site will primarily function as a writers' collective and community hub. As time progresses and our means increase, the digital library will be filled with essential texts and analysis.

landing.aboutP1: Marxist.info is a digital platform dedicated to advancing Marxist theory and research in the 21st century. Our mission is to provide a comprehensive resource for scholars, students, and activists interested in understanding and applying Marxist analysis to contemporary issues.
landing.offer1: A curated digital library of classic and contemporary Marxist texts
landing.offer2: Interactive timelines of historical events and theoretical developments
landing.offer3: A glossary of key concepts and terminology
landing.offer4: Discussion forums for theoretical debate and collaboration
landing.offer5: Study tools and resources for individual and group learning
landing.earlyAccessP: We're currently in early access with limited spots available. Users with invite codes get immediate full access, while others can join our waitlist to be notified when more spots open up or when we launch public beta.
landing.guestAccessP: You can browse the Home page and Digital Library as a guest without an account. Full features like Theory, Study tools, Forum, and Profile require registration with an invite code.
landing.featStudyDesc: A structured learning environment featuring curated reading lists, study guides, and theoretical discussions to develop Marxist understanding systematically.
landing.featScienceDesc: As Lenin emphasized, communists should know everything mankind has to offer. Dedicated to ensuring Marxists are thoroughly educated in natural sciences and all fields of human knowledge.
landing.featLibraryDesc: An expanding collection of essential Marxist texts, articles, and analyses, organized and annotated for accessibility and theoretical development.
landing.featDataDesc: Tools for tracking global economic developments and staying updated on the evolving conditions of capitalist production and class struggle.
landing.featWritersDesc: A collaborative space for developing revolutionary thinkers and writers, emphasizing quality theoretical work that contributes to the Marxist tradition.
landing.featForumDesc: Engage in theoretical discussions with fellow researchers, theorists, and activists building revolutionary understanding.
